final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.average_rate
